component.name: Perigee
component.summary: Control remote game and workstation streams from one in-stream deck

description.p: Perigee is a Moonlight-based client for remote games and workstations. The Perigee Deck provides searchable session controls in the video window.
Perigee uses enhanced Polaris controls when the paired host advertises them.
Perigee keeps the standard Moonlight streaming path for Sunshine hosts.
Initial development release of the Perigee Deck and Polaris controls.
